title: Comfort that need not bind you

captions.energy: Making routines serve binding material comfort

meaning: Comfort chosen together supports you when familiar convenience does not remove freedom to receive simpler, living care.
text: You can make a home through mutual participation: choosing pleasant things together, considering needs and seeking comfort for two. The Lovers in the physical position of Muladhara describe this openness in action. The Devil in energy tests your footing through attachment to a particular comfort that has become difficult to reduce or change. The Empress in emotions wants care, acceptance and a sense of enough. Warmth becomes harder to receive, however, when pleasure acquires compulsory conditions and a good evening needs more objects, time and unchanging maintenance of its familiar form.

For example, you create a green corner together. Plants gradually become so numerous that resting beside them begins with lengthy care each evening. **Chosen comfort can stay pleasant at a smaller scale.** Loving greenery need not be proved by keeping every new pot. Care can again include both people, beyond sustaining an environment meant to make life easier that now demands increasing attention for itself.

The difficulty is treating reduction as losing a shared dream. You organise care better and buy further conveniences without changing the load. Feeling sufficient grows more distant. Greater domestic warmth appears when joint choice allows reconsideration, and valuing invested care does not oblige you to preserve every material result regardless of both people’s current comfort. Your arrangement can then keep serving you.
